title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

title: Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
summary: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
summary: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
summary: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.
